name: ibis Bangkok IMPACT
short_description: A budget ibis at IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre with a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (2,367 reviews), all-day dining, and 24-hour reception.
ai_summary: ibis Bangkok IMPACT sits at the heart of the IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre in Nonthaburi, greater Bangkok, next door to the sister Novotel Bangkok Impact. The property holds a strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from a very large base of 2,367 reviews. Facilities include an all-day dining Café/Restaurant, GROOVE & GREENS Cafe, round-the-clock reception, and 24-hour meal options. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 93 Popular Road, Banmai Subdistrict, Pakkred District, 11120 Nonthaburi, Thailand
core_facts.neighborhood: IMPACT Muang Thong Thani, Nonthaburi (greater Bangkok)
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from an unusually large base of 2,367 reviews for a budget-tier ibis
Directly at IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre — the natural budget choice for MICE travellers
All-day dining, GROOVE & GREENS Cafe, and 24-hour reception/meal options
cons: Nonthaburi location is well outside central Bangkok — not ideal for leisure travellers wanting to be near the city centre
research_highlights: Located directly at IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre, 24-hour dining
